_ai: AI-assisted: compiled with an AI coding assistant (Claude) from the sources below on 2026-11-14 and reviewed by the team. Every value is a default the farmer can overwrite.
_verify: Values marked verified=false come from secondary summaries of the official publication; check them against the original before submission.

isu_2026.name: Iowa State University Extension, Estimated Costs of Crop Production in Iowa - 2026 (FM 1712, Ag Decision Maker A1-20)
isu_2026.note: Total cost per acre including land rent, machinery and labour; planning benchmark, not a farm-specific estimate. Figures read from a secondary summary (fencerow.farm).

ers_2025.name: USDA ERS Commodity Costs and Returns, 2025 forecast of total costs per planted acre (US average)
ers_2025.note: National average total costs, read from an American Farm Bureau summary (fb.org, 'Significant Farm Losses Persist').

wasde_2026_11.name: USDA World Agricultural Supply and Demand Estimates, November 2026 (2026/27 season-average farm price)
wasde_2026_11.note: Season-average farm price forecast; local cash prices and basis differ.

team_catalogue.name: Team crop catalogue (backend/catalog/crops_us.csv), US mean yield
